IQAE (1) achieves a quadratic speed-up up to a double-logarithmic factor compared to the state-of-the-art classical Monte Carlo simulation and (2) outperforms other QAE algorithms without QPE by orders of magnitude.

IQAE is a QAE algorithm without QPE that achieves a quadratic speed-up over classical Monte Carlo simulation, has a provably small overhead compared to QAE and is empirically superior over known QAE algorithms without QPE.
